label: Iterative categorization (IC): a systematic technique for analysing qualitative data
notes: Strong support for the chapter’s ‘iterative logic’ and practical analysis workflow: IC provides a clear, transparent progression from coded text to descriptive and interpretive findings (including audit-trail style summaries). Less directly about qualitative Inhaltsanalyse terminology, but valuable for step models and operationalization. Several key figures (coding frame, coded-data extracts, summarized analyses) are visual and not well preserved in text extraction.
